review.evidenceBasis: The inheritance lane emits no new LLM title-to-spec decisions: child rows are deterministic derivations of owner-approved parent rows via Videos/drafts/_p4/inheritance-map.json (idf-weighted title-token containment >= 0.55, >= 3 informative tokens). Review targeted the derivation itself: 12 (child, spec) pairs sampled across all six lane families (CIE AS, Edexcel double-award linear, CIE maths core->extended, IAL sciences, Edexcel maths modular units, CIE combined science) and checked child-title vs parent-title vs parent approved rows. The sample exposed degenerate 1.0-containment matches on trivially short spec titles ('Calculate with money.', 'E = Q this equation', 'r = BQ a magnetic field') — one of which carried a parent row and would have emitted a wrong row. Fix applied (min 3 informative tokens), map regenerated, all three pairs confirmed excluded, sample re-verified. Semantics of the surviving mid-band (0.55-0.6) matches spot-confirmed sound (energy-level vs reaction-pathway diagrams; chromatogram interpretation).
